chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad narrated from Ibn Maḥbūb, from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ḥamzah, from Abī Baṣīr, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man who commits zina many times in a single day.

He said: “If he commits zina with one woman, such-and-such number of times, then only one hadd punishment is upon him. But if he commits zina with different women in one day and in one hour, then upon him there is a hadd punishment for every woman with whom he committed immorality.”

key_terms.الْيَوْمِ الْوَاحِدِ: a single day; indicating repeated acts within the same day
key_terms.بِنِسْوَةٍ شَتَّى: with different women; indicating multiple distinct persons
key_terms.حَدٌّ وَاحِدٌ: one hadd punishment; a single fixed legal penalty
key_terms.فَجَرَ بِهَا: committed immorality with her; engaged in a gravely illicit sexual act
key_terms.يَزْنِي: commits zina; engages in unlawful sexual intercourse

ai.seo_question: How many hadd punishments apply if a man commits zina multiple times in one day?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the hadd of zina when the act is repeated. If the repetition is with the same woman, one hadd applies, but if it is with multiple women, a separate hadd applies for each woman.
